analysis_unit: encoded interval between shared offsets within one native locus
limitations: encoded intervals are not pixel masks, manuscript glyphs or linguistic word spans
locus-level drawing/comma counts do not locate those markers inside a span
related exposed sources/policies/spans are not independent samples or untouched evaluation
method: minimal shared-anchor encoded boundary spans v1

processing.anchor_rule: consecutive shared internal ASCII offsets plus common locus endpoints
processing.different_chain_rule: excluded from alignment, with all native keys retained
processing.part_rule: original complete tokens between shared anchors; no partial-token cuts
processing.separator_scope: all adapter separators; locus drawing/comma counts retained, span-specific types unresolved
